prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup
Asset type: one high-fidelity shippable portrait mobile-web landing page UI direction comp, 9:16
Primary request: Design the SettleUp landing page as “The Paper Phone Circle,” a practical mobile-first interface whose signature visual is hand-cranked paper automata and pinned mechanical toys. SettleUp turns real bank transactions into friend-group expenses.
Surface structure: Show the actual flat webpage canvas edge-to-edge with no phone hardware, no browser chrome, no device frame, and no surrounding scene. At the top, a compact navigation row with the SettleUp wordmark at left and Sign in at right. Next, a sharply legible hero headline and a prominent Connect a bank button. The dominant first-viewport object is one large cut-paper phone centered above a small, thin horizontal crank line with a tactile crank handle. Below it, let the page continue into a scroll-stage preview: the crank mechanism unfolds a circular ring of several connected paper phones around one shared charge, clearly communicating a transaction becoming a friend-group expense. This lower stage should peek into view while keeping the single phone and headline as the opening focal point.
Subject/UI content: On the single phone or shared-charge center, show a clean transaction row reading Luna Pizza · $84.20. Around the connected ring, show Jamie, Noor, Eli as the three friend labels, legible and evenly associated with the shared charge. Keep the financial amount exact.
Style/medium: realistic, production-ready mobile web UI mockup rendered with refined tactile cut-paper construction, editorial clarity, generous spacing, and accessible hierarchy. Sophisticated paper engineering rather than childish craft. Hand-cut edges are subtle and controlled. Visible tabs, slender paper linkages, tiny brass pivot pins, and a believable hand-crank mechanism provide the signature character.
Color palette: cream and kraft #E9E0CD background and paper surfaces, charcoal #34322F type and shadows, muted crimson #B3473F for the primary action and selective mechanical accents, paper sage #B6AD91 for secondary phone layers. Flat color only.
Materials/textures: restrained kraft fiber, layered cut paper, fine charcoal cast shadows, tiny brass pins, precise die-cut tabs; crisp enough for a financial product and never dusty or distressed.
Typography: large, editorial, highly readable charcoal typography with clean mobile-web spacing. All text must be spelled exactly and appear only once except names may each appear once. Do not add any other words, labels, numerals, icons with text, legal copy, captions, badges, or navigation items.
Text (verbatim, the only permitted UI copy): “SettleUp”; “One charge. Everyone accounted for.”; “Connect a bank”; “Sign in”; “Luna Pizza · $84.20”; “Jamie, Noor, Eli”.
Constraints: shippable landing page UI, not a poster; visitor immediately understands bank transaction sharing with friends; primary button clearly tappable; 9:16 portrait; crisp readable text; precise amount; practical hierarchy; enough lower scroll-stage content to prove the circular phone mechanism; no invented product claims.
Avoid: device photograph, phone held in a hand, environmental scene, poster composition, concept-art title card, toy-store styling, juvenile scrapbook look, generic floating cards, stock photography, gradients, glassmorphism, neon, glossy plastic, excessive decoration, tiny unreadable text, duplicate copy, extra copy, misspellings, altered punctuation, watermarks, unrelated logos.
